title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): New template for getting started with creating agents
summary: In BC28, the AL Language extension adds an Agent template to the AL: New Project command in VS Code, and the template comes with getting-started instructions for building Business Central agents. Setting up a project means picking an empty folder, entering a starting object ID, choosing a server and downloading symbols.
key_points: A new Agent template is available via the AL: New Project command in VS Code
The template includes instructions for getting started with agent development
Users configure object ID ranges, select servers, and download symbol files through the template workflow
This builds on the AL: New Project command introduced in BC26

quotes.text: You can easily design and code agents using this template.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the practical benefit for agent development workflows
